name: Local and cloud model center
userOutcome: The user can configure cloud endpoints, inspect local runtime health, install and benchmark local models, and assign them safely.
productionDataSource: Provider configuration, Keychain references, Ollama or local endpoint APIs, model definitions, runtime health, and benchmarks.
errorBehavior: Keep safe metadata, never reveal credentials, preserve recoverable runtime state, and explain storage, network, or capability failures.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not download or remove without explicit confirmation.
acceptanceTests: Pull a small approved model with progress.
Deny cloud use in local-only mode.
